art_instructions: Draw a small, cozy wooden schoolhouse with a steep roof, wide windows, and a wraparound porch with tiny steps leading to the entrance. The school sits on short stilts, surrounded by tall oak and maple trees with scattered leaves on the ground. Place Owl perched on the edge of the porch or low fence, looking up at the school entrance with a calm, alert expression. Owl has round amber eyes, mottled brown-and-cream feathers, and a small green scarf tied at her neck. Show her tiny satchel slung across her body. Position her slightly off-center to the left, with the school occupying the middle and background. The lighting is bright and sunny, casting soft shadows. Use warm browns for the wooden walls, bright yellow for window frames, and soft green for surrounding grass. Ensure the camera is at child level, as if a young viewer is standing near Owl.
